source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: The Defender places a unit first, then the players alternate. Each placement puts one unit entirely inside its own deployment zone. Keep the units assigned to **strategic reserves** during [formation declarations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations) off the battlefield. If you deploy a **TITANIC** unit, give up your next placement. The other player can finish placing their units once you have placed yours.

detail.afterOneFinishes: other player deploys remaining eligible units
